knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A strong partner reaches the same people the business wants to serve, with a good reputation. A competitor or a business with no clients does not help.
Written terms, disclosure and legal advice are the required steps. Verbal-only or unrecorded payment is the wrong approach.
The agreement must cover money, access, insurance and records. Exercise preferences and opening hours alone leave the key terms open.

practicalCriteria: The learner scores five partner candidates with reasons, and the assessor confirms each score matches the stated criteria
The learner drafts a one-page partnership note that contains each element named in the lesson
The learner leaves each payment and insurance point out where advice has not been obtained
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: List of points still to be checked
stopWorkCriteria: Stop any referral payment that is not disclosed and recorded
Stop training at a venue or home without written access and insurance terms
